rInternal.note: Energizer CR2025 (Li/MnO2). Datasheet "Internal Resistance Characteristics" graph: IR about 8.5 ohm on a fresh cell, about 9 ohm by 25 mAh (read from the graph, right axis 0 to 120 ohm), rising past 100 ohm near end of life. 21 C.

limits.note: No maximum continuous current is published. The Panasonic CR2025 datasheet gives "Continuous drain 0.2mA" as its standard drain and charts continuous loads only down to 1 kOhm; 3 V across 1 kOhm is about 3 mA, where capacity is about 120 of 165 mAh at 20 C.

notes: rInternal is a fresh cell at room temperature: it rises as the cell discharges and in the cold.
sourceCurrent is compared as a rating (sim-over-limit warning), not as a hard cut-off.

corrected.why: IR curve read by pixel against the 0 to 120 ohm right axis: about 8.5 ohm at 0 mAh, about 9 ohm by 25 mAh; "about 10" was high
